question: How Many Milkshake Flavors Does Cook Out Have?
quick_answer: Cook Out has more than 40 milkshake flavors, from classics like vanilla, chocolate and strawberry to Southern favorites like Banana Pudding, Peach Cobbler and Cheerwine. A few, such as eggnog and fresh watermelon, are seasonal. You can also mix flavors in one cup. Shakes cost about $3 to $4 depending on location, and they're known for being extremely thick.
key_facts: Seasonal flavors include eggnog and fresh watermelon
You can combine flavors in one cup
About $3 to $4 per shake, varying by location
Shakes are famously thick; many people use a spoon

body.heading: Classic flavors
body.text: Every Cook Out menu board starts with the basics: Vanilla, Chocolate and Strawberry, plus fruit flavors such as Banana, Blueberry, Peach and Pineapple. From there, the menu adds mix-ins and nut flavors like Banana Nut, Walnut, Chocolate Chip Mint and Cookie Dough. Flavor lists vary slightly from store to store, so if a flavor isn't posted, it's worth asking.

body.heading: Candy and dessert flavors
body.text: Some of Cook Out's most ordered shakes are built around candy and desserts. Oreo, Reese's Cup, Snickers and Butterfinger shakes mix crushed candy into the ice cream, while Cheesecake, Banana Pudding and Peach Cobbler taste like Southern desserts in a cup. Peanut Butter Fudge and Caramel Fudge are other common picks.

body.heading: Cheerwine and seasonal shakes
body.text: Cook Out serves Cheerwine, the cherry soda from North Carolina, and you can get it as a shake or float, a Carolina favorite. Seasonal shakes rotate through the year. Eggnog shows up around the holidays, and the fresh watermelon shake is a summer-only flavor many fans wait for.

body.heading: Mixing flavors and secret combos
body.text: Those 40-plus flavors are only the start, because Cook Out lets you combine flavors in one shake. Fans often order Oreo combos like Peanut Butter Oreo or Oreo Cheesecake, and Strawberry Cheesecake is a well-known off-menu pick that staff usually recognize. Just tell the cashier which flavors you want blended.

body.heading: Price and how to order
body.text: Cook Out doesn't post prices online, and shakes typically cost about $3 to $4 depending on location. You can also swap the drink in a Cook Out Tray for a milkshake for an extra charge. The shakes are so thick that many people eat them with a spoon. For other prices, see our Cook Out menu page.

faqs.q: How many milkshake flavors does Cook Out have?
faqs.a: More than 40, plus seasonal flavors and combinations.

faqs.q: Can you mix milkshake flavors at Cook Out?
faqs.a: Yes. You can combine flavors in one cup, such as Peanut Butter Oreo or Strawberry Cheesecake.

faqs.q: Does Cook Out have a Cheerwine milkshake?
faqs.a: Yes. Cheerwine, the North Carolina cherry soda, is available as a shake or a float.

faqs.q: How much is a Cook Out milkshake?
faqs.a: About $3 to $4, depending on location. Cook Out doesn't publish prices online.

faqs.q: What are Cook Out's seasonal milkshakes?
faqs.a: Seasonal flavors include eggnog around the holidays and fresh watermelon in summer.
